description: Renovate maintains the GitHub Actions pins and the Python dependencies of the validator (pyproject.toml and uv.lock), as in the other hegemony-sh repositories. Every `uses:` is pinned to a commit SHA, and without something bumping them they rot silently. Third-party releases wait a week before they are proposed (minimumReleaseAge); security fixes do not. Its commits are chore(deps), a scope .commitlintrc.yaml allows.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A known vulnerability is not weekly business: these bypass the schedule and are labelled so they stand out.
